source_note: Verbatim transcript pasted by the user from a meeting export for the real "Meeting with Jamleh" (project: Jamileh's Product Website), 2026-08-08. This export has no real per-segment UUIDs and every turn shares the same displayed timestamp (1:59:47 PM). Per instruction, segment_index is the literal, deterministic, source-order identity (1..378, exact original turn order, never derived from the uninformative shared timestamp) -- lib/transcript-order.ts's canonicalTranscriptOrder sorts by segment_index (tier 1) ahead of timestamp, so source order is preserved exactly. `id` is a deterministic UUID-shaped string (00000000-0000-4000-8000-<12-hex-digit segment_index>) rather than the literal string "website_segment_NNNN": every V4 stage's segment-boundary regex (SEGMENT_LINE/SEGMENT_PREFIX, e.g. lib/execution-intelligence/stages.ts) and every WorkItem.source_segment_ids field is Zod-validated with z.string().uuid() -- a literal "website_segment_0001" fails that validation and gets silently dropped by the model-output salvage step, producing zero extracted work items (confirmed by an initial failed replay: extraction reported success but returned 0 items). The UUID-shaped id is still 100% deterministic and fixture-only (the all-zero prefix and monotonic suffix make it unmistakably synthetic, never a real database UUID) and is fully traceable back to source order via segment_index.
